name: Gemini
source:
Main character lives together with cute twin sisters-in-law. The girls are obsessed by taking care of their onii-chan. They wish to give him their first time.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公与一对可爱的双胞胎义妹同住一个屋檐下。姐妹俩一门心思围着心爱的“哥哥”转，无微不至地照料他的起居，更满心期盼着能将彼此的初夜献给他。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-march-2004-remember11-age.html]vndbreview[/url]]
